app.purpose: Canonical AOC v0 example used to prove the YAML <-> JSON lossless interchange claim. The paired _canonical.json file holds the same object tree in lossless JSON form. The pair carries no comments inside the structure so the round-trip stays byte-stable under standard parser normalization.

anti_claims: A0 — AOC is a legibility commitment, not an enforcement commitment.
A9 — AOC projects into MCP, OpenAPI, A2A, WebMCP, llms.txt, Anthropic Skills, and OpenAI Apps SDK; it does not replace any of them.
